none: PAS FindID 995623: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Emperor right, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: probably DN VAL[--]. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right dragging captive and holding labarum. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Diameter: 17.1mm, Weight: 1.59gms, die axis: 12
